title.ar: تفسير القرآن من الجامع لابن وهب
title.en: Qur'anic Exegesis from Ibn Wahb's Compendium

author.name_ar: أبو محمد عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم المصري القرشي

structureNote: Numbered reports from Ibn Wahb's Jami in the transmission of Sahnun. Volume 3 holds readings, codices, abrogation and prostration verses. The source prints no surah or verse references, so passages carry none.

translation.conventions: English translation of the Arabic text (Shamela book 37361). Page numbering, ordering, and entry numbers follow the source; the editor's page markers appear as p. N. Passages the source Arabic renders unintelligibly, and editorial lacunae, are marked in square brackets.
